findings.evidence: `abbrev mkQ : Comodule.Hom R C M (M ⧸ N.toSubmodule)` (line 168); other morphisms use `def` (Comodule.lean:178 `def comp`, Corestrict.lean:189 `def corestrictHom`).
findings.fix: Make `mkQ` a `def`; adjust `mkQ_surjective` (line 184) to go through `mkQ_apply`/`funext` instead of relying on defeq to `N.toSubmodule.mkQ_surjective`.
findings.issue: `mkQ` is an `abbrev`, making the whole `Comodule.Hom` structure (its `map_coact` proof and `toLinearMap := N.toSubmodule.mkQ`) reducibly unfold at every use site — a fully exposed body. Comparable comodule morphisms (`Comodule.Hom.comp`, `corestrictHom`, `transportHom`) are `def`, and the characteristic lemmas `mkQ_toLinearMap`/`mkQ_apply` already supply the needed API.

findings.evidence: Both lemmas prove `(N.liftQ f hf).comp N.mkQ = f`; the docstring on line 261 says "Alias for `Subcomodule.liftQ_comp_mkQ`".
findings.fix: Drop one; if the Mathlib-style name `liftQ_mkQ` is wanted, keep only it and carry the `@[simp]` attribute there.
findings.issue: `liftQ_mkQ` is a verbatim restatement of the `@[simp]` lemma `liftQ_comp_mkQ` (line 253) — identical statement and proof, duplicating public surface.

summary: The quotient comodule and its universal property are characterized and annotated well, but `mkQ` is declared `abbrev`, needlessly exposing the bundled morphism body reducibly, and `liftQ_mkQ` duplicates `liftQ_comp_mkQ`.
